languageSpecifications.intro_line2: Alexandre Astier has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He fell off his horse while wearing armor at the great Cameliard tournament. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line3: Antoine Wonders has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He cut himself while creating a board game. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line4: Boromir Stark has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He was wounded during an acupuncture session with his Orc buddies. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line5: Elsa Blue has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She got stuck in her freezer while she was defrosting it. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line6: Frank Enstein has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He was electrocuted by a mad scientist. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line7: Lila Runcloud has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She burnt her finger with the laser vegetable peeler she was using. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line8: Mr Phal has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. His beard got caught in his bicycle's gears during a race. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line9: Roberto Traga has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He slipped while leaping from the bridge of his ship and broke his leg. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line10: Rose Well has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She crashed her flying saucer in a nearby desert. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line11: Ryan Private has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He suffers from amnesia after a blow to his helmet. You must help him find himself. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line12: Castella Castalo has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. She sprained her vocal cords at her last concert. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.intro_line13: Willy Free has just arrived at the hospital's emergency room. He suffers from Tuna - related food poisoning, his stomach must be operated on immediately. Now it's up to you!
languageSpecifications.event_line1: The air conditioning has failed! Dab/wipe the forehead of each of the other players.
languageSpecifications.event_line2: It's your birthday! All of the other players must sing: "Happy Birthday" and kiss your cheeks. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line3: Complete blackout! All of the players close their eyes and shout: "Who's the idiot who cut off the power?" Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line4: The hospital has two new managers! Each player shakes the hand of the player on their left and introduces themselves by their first name, last name, and their job Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line5: The patient you're operating on is a celebrity! Now take a picture of all the players and post it on social media! Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line6: The C - section is successful! All of the players need to kiss the baby (the youngest player) on the cheeks. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line7: There's a surprise gear inspection! All of the Instrument cards must be sterilized. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line8: Players have gotten an <strong>electric shock<strong>! One player from each team must lie on the ground and another player must mime 10 cardiac massages.
languageSpecifications.event_line9: The patient is a famous spy, there are hidden microphones in the operating room! Players must speak in hushed tones until the end of the current test.
languageSpecifications.event_line10: We won the cup! All of the players jump in place out of joy, with their arms in the air, shouting: "And one, and two, and three, zero!"
languageSpecifications.event_line11: The players have forgotten to put on gloves! All of the players must mime, with sound effects, the act of putting on a pair of gloves. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line12: There's a helium leak! All players must talk with high - pitched voices until the end of the current test. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line13: The patient is hemorraging! One player from each team must put a finger on the patient's heart until the end of the current test.
languageSpecifications.event_line14: There's an inspection of the team. Each player must make a house with 2 instrument cards. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line15: Your team is international! Each player must choose an accent and use it until the end of the current test. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line16: All of the players are training for a marathon! They must move around the table once while shouting: "One, two, one, two…" Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line17: New gear has just been delivered. All of the players must go to the room's door and sign this card as if it was the delivery notice. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line18: A fly slipped into the operating room! Throw a card in the air while shouting: "Watch out for the fly!" Another player must catch the card and put it back in its place. Otherwise, you need to do it again!
languageSpecifications.event_line19: The irreproachable work of your team is congratulated! All of the players shake each others' hands while saying: "Congratulations, you do excellent work!" Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line20: There's a suspicious smell in the operating room! All of the players continue the current test while pinching their nose. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line21: An oxygen leak has been detected in the operating room! All of the players lie on the ground, with their hands on their heads, then count all together to 10. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line22: There's a power outage! To get the power back on, all of the players must lie on their backs and pedal while counting out loud to 10. Completed!
languageSpecifications.event_line23: The radiation alert has just started! All players rush to the nearest toilet, and enclose it count aloud to 10.
languageSpecifications.event_line24: The new intern tipped over the cart holding all of the instruments! Toss 5 Instrument cards on the ground. The players must put them back in place.
languageSpecifications.event_line25: There's an earthquake! All of the players must jump in place until the end of the current test.
languageSpecifications.credit_line2: The "Doctor Panic" boardgame is required to play.
